desc:
Welcome to Islands Reborn! A fan-made recreation of the classic version of Islands, bringing back the nostalgia of the original 2020-2021 experience.

🌲 Build your own island
👨‍🌾 Create huge farms
💸 Sell items to make money
🍳 Cook tasty delicacies
✨ Gather valuable resources
🔥 And more!

💎 Gamepass perks use the ORIGINAL Islands gamepasses. All purchases support the original developers, not me.

Play the official game here: https://www.roblox.com/games/4872321990/Islands

🛑 WARNINGS:
 Duping = Ban.
 Exploiting = Ban.

CREDITS:
Original game by Easy.gg.
Music by LawnReality.

⚠️ This is an unofficial fan project created for nostalgia purposes only. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Easy.gg. All rights to Islands belong to their respective owners.
